messages:
maya.g: quick knock — can we lock final owners + due dates for the INC-921 postmortem actions? I want to commit timelines by EOD PST. below is my current read, pls confirm or correct.

anton: I can own the 'db failover playbook update' task. target: Mon 2026-03-23 EOD. blocking: infra review from @devops-bridge.

devops-bridge: noted. we can do the infra review, aiming for 2026-03-22. i'll ping infra-eng and add review notes here.

sarah-l: I can take 'alert thresholds + dashboard updates' but i'm waiting on the telemetry PR merge (data-team/telemetry#412). ETA for me is Tue 2026-03-24 assuming that lands.

kevin: i'll pick up 'canary retry backoff adjustment + tests' — plan Wed 2026-03-25. will add a small e2e to cover the path.

maya.g: thanks. can folks paste the tracker line so I can paste into the RCA doc? small format works. e.g.

```
- owner: anton
  action: update db failover playbook and runbook
  due: 2026-03-23
  deps: devops-bridge review
```

anton: added to tracker: https://tracker.redwood.local/INC-921/actions#3 — confirmed due 2026-03-23.

devops-bridge: review task created and assigned to infra-eng (ticket INFRA-1229). estimated review complete by 2026-03-22.

sarah-l: tracker line added: `- owner: sarah-l; action: telemetry thresholds + dashboards; due: 2026-03-24; deps: data-team PR`.

kevin: added my line and a short test plan. link: https://tracker.redwood.local/INC-921/actions#7. will open a draft PR today.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-921 reminder: postmortem draft due in 7 days. Automated follow-up scheduled.

maya.g: quick cross-team check — confirmed deps:
- anton needs infra review from devops-bridge (INFRA-1229)
- sarah-l needs data-team PR merge (data-team/telemetry#412)
- kevin needs e2e approvals from qa-team once PR is up
Any other hidden blockers? If none, i'll mark these as committed and set the tracker state to "committed" at 4:00pm PST.

sarah-l: i'll prod data-team today and update the tracker if the PR moves forward.

anton: if infra review slips, I may need a 1-day buffer — i'll call it out asap.

kevin: :thumbsup: i'll try to have the draft PR by EOD so approvals can start.

maya.g: perfect. last ask — can each of you drop a 1-line verification in the RCA doc when your task is done (so SRE and support can close the loop)? I'll check in tomorrow morning and do a sweep before finalizing.

kevin: will do.

sarah-l: yes, will add verification notes.

anton: added a quick checklist item to the runbook page after my changes.

maya.g: thanks everyone — closing the loop here. if anything changes before 4pm PST, ping me in-thread or DM. :wave:
